verdict.rationale: Zulip documents an integrations directory with 130+ native prebuilt integrations plus Zapier/IFTTT connectivity, which team-admins can install directly (zulip-docs-9, zulip-docs-13, zulip-docs-19). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the install/admin UX for adding integrations and no detail on install permission/approval flow for admins.
